purpose: Read-only fixed-coefficient decomposition of already saved training rewards; no replay, fitting, model selection or training.
benchmark: Existing next-open whole-share buy_hold baseline, raw split/dividend accounting, default initial capital/costs; no artificial end liquidation.
windows: Exactly the prior52 phase/symbol trajectories and26 fixed513-row training windows ending2020-12-02; no new path or source outcomes.
precision: Float32 stored policy and benchmark log-equity rewards; diagnostic subtraction and discounted sums accumulated in float64.
metrics: Per-episode population reward and primary zero-tail discounted-target variances/covariances; equal episode mean within stock/ETF groups, plus pooled descriptive metrics. Verify var(P-B)=var(P)+var(B)-2cov(P,B).

feasibility_gate.zero_policy_variance: Fail feasibility, not an undefined success
feasibility_gate.failure: Close fixed coefficient-one subtraction hypothesis; no coefficient/benchmark/window/discount grid or automatic training.
feasibility_gate.success: Only supports proposing a separate preregistered training experiment; no model performance or promotion claim.

limitations: Observed path variation is not irreducible noise, expected-value accuracy, gradient variance or economic improvement. Targets overlap; only one stochastic path per symbol/phase. Subtracting the same realized baseline from a prediction and target leaves their error unchanged. No true policy-invariance claim with action-dependent termination/bootstrapping.
